title: OpenAlex budget used up
detail: OpenAlex daily budget is used up (resets at midnight UTC). Set OPENALEX_API_KEY (free key: https://help.openalex.org/api/authentication/) and run again. (first seen 2026-10-10 12:55 UTC). Affected: citation counts for people without a Scholar profile, author lists from ORCID, and the independent check of every paper.
action: Create a key at openalex.org (free tier first), then in the shell that runs the pipeline: export OPENALEX_API_KEY=...  and  make snapshot. Do not paste the key into chat or commit it.

title: No confirmed OpenAlex author ID
detail: Their papers are checked by exact title only (and by Scholar's own author list). An author ID makes the independent check stronger.

title: Papers whose author list could not be checked
detail: Scholar prints a cut author list that does not show the person and no independent record was found. They are shown, not counted.
action: fetch_scholar.py --details --only <slug> reads the full list; or decide per paper in paper_overrides.csv.

title: Venues the matcher could not classify
detail: Counted papers whose venue is neither a journal in SCImago nor a conference in CORE, nor a preprint or patent. They sit in 'Other'.
action: Add rows to backend/venue_overrides.csv (venue, kind, quartile, core_rank).

title: People with no Scholar profile figure
detail: Papers come from Researchmap, ORCID or OpenAlex; citation counts are OpenAlex's, which index fewer papers than Scholar, so their totals are not comparable with Scholar totals.
